headlines.title: Marriott (MAR) Stock Fair Value Rises After Q3 Beat And Higher Guidance
headlines.summary: Price targets for Marriott International have shifted into a higher range, with recent Street estimates now clustering between about US$400 and US$470, above the prior fair value estimate of roughly US$390.81 and closer to the updated figure near US$421.73. Analysts are tying these higher targets to Q3 results, raised guidance and a growing development pipeline, while also flagging some caution after the stock’s rally.

headlines.title: Marriott International Stock: Analyst Estimates & Ratings
headlines.summary: Marriott International has outperformed the broader market and its industry peers, while Wall Street analysts maintain a cautiously optimistic outlook on its growth prospects.

headlines.title: Marriott (MAR) Stock May Be 45% Overvalued On Fee Based Cash Flow
headlines.summary: Marriott International has ridden a powerful share price run in recent years, which puts fresh attention on what investors are actually paying for in terms of its cash flows. With the stock recently closing at US$425.90, the core issue is whether that market price still lines up with the cash the business can generate and return over time. Over the past 5 years, Marriott International has delivered a total shareholder return of 181.

description: Marriott International, Inc. engages in the operation, franchising, and licensing of hotel, residential, timeshare, and other lodging properties in the United States, Canada, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Greater China, the Asia-Pacific, and internationally. The company operates properties under the JW Marriott, The Ritz-Carlton, The Luxury Collection, W Hotels, St. Regis, EDITION, Bvlgari, Marriott Hotels, Sheraton, Westin, Autograph Collection, Renaissance Hotels, Le Méridien, Delta Hotels by Marriott, MGM Collection with Marriott Bonvoy, Tribute Portfolio, Gaylord Hotels, Design Hotels, Marriott Executive Apartments, Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy, Courtyard by Marriott, Fairfield by Marriott, Residence Inn by Marriott, SpringHill Suites by Marriott, Four Points by Sheraton, TownePlace Suites by Marriott, Aloft Hotels, AC Hotels by Marriott, Moxy Hotels, Element Hotels, Protea Hotels by Marriott, citizenM, City Express by Marriott, and Four Points Flex by Sheraton brands. It also operates residences, timeshares, and yachts. The company was formerly known as New Marriott MI, Inc. and changed its name to Marriott International, Inc. in May 1998. Marriott International, Inc. was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland.
